The '''Criminal Gallery''' was a section inside the [[Galactic Museum/Legends|Galactic Museum]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] went there after taking the witness stand in [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu's]] [[Trial of Tycho Celchu|trial]].
